crossRefs.note: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”
The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the…
If we should say, ‘From men’ ”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.
But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”
Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

parallels.note: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

translations.web: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”
translations.bsb: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
translations.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
translations.asv: for they said, Not during the feast, lest haply there shall be a tumult of the people.
